# Committee for the Arts

**Notice of Public Meeting**
City of Gloucester

**Date and Time:** September 29, 2026 — 11am-12:30pm

**Location:** Harbor Master's Conference Room, 19 Harbor Loop, Gloucester, MA 01930

**Zoom Link:** https://gloucester-ma-gov.zoom.us/j/81138441017

**Phone One-Tap:**
- +13052241968, 81138441017# US
- +13092053325, 81138441017# US

**Note:** Listed items may be heard out of order.

## Agenda

- Call to Order
- Approval of the July 28 Minutes

### New Business

1. Arts, Culture, and Events Coordinator update
2. Poet Laureate
3. CPA-funded projects: status
4. CFTA Policies and Practices: status
5. O'Maley fish sculptures (follow up discussion)
6. Jason Grow Vietnam Portraits (follow up discussion)

## Adjournment

The listing of matters is those reasonably anticipated by the Chair, which may be discussed at the meeting. Not all items may in fact be discussed and other items not listed may also be brought up for discussion to the extent permitted by law.
summary: The Committee for the Arts will meet to discuss updates on the Arts, Culture, and Events Coordinator position, the Poet Laureate, CPA-funded projects, committee policies and practices, and follow-up discussions on the O'Maley fish sculptures and Jason Grow Vietnam Portraits.
